title: TLS 1.3 tickets become unusable within seven days
natural_language: 客户端缓存 TLS 1.3 NewSessionTicket 后，最迟七天内必须使该 ticket 过期或移除，不得继续用于 PSK 恢复。
standard_excerpt: Clients MUST NOT cache tickets for longer than 7 days
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.tls13_ticket_cached: A parsed TLS 1.3 NewSessionTicket is admitted to the client session cache.
ap_definitions.tls13_ticket_became_unusable: Adapter/client marks the ticket ineligible at min(ticket_lifetime,604800s).
ap_definitions.tls13_ticket_removed: The correlated session ticket is removed from cache before the maximum age.

correlation_key: SSL_SESSION pointer/cache key + ticket nonce/hash; ticket bytes never become AP names
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: Record ticket creation after tls_process_new_session_ticket stores tick_lifetime_hint; emit unusable when the PSK age check first rejects it or adapter expiry fires.
review_question: OpenSSL 0437435a checks the advertised lifetime but does not explicitly expose the RFC seven-day cap;请确认使用 adapter 合成 max-age 事件并把潜在超长 ticket 视为可发现违规。
limitations: Requires virtual time. The source hook observes ticket age eligibility; explicit cache eviction may be lazy, so the formal AP is unusable-or-removed rather than memory freed.
independent_audit_note: Rejected: consequent was adapter-derived and self-fulfilling; no fixed cache/use transition proves seven-day non-use.
